{{Quote|A hefty half-rack of nos monster ribs prepared in the traditional Pau'an manner of Utapau.|Dex's Diner menu, on its baby nos ribs|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Nos monster ribs''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] consisting of the [[Rib/Legends|ribs]]<ref name="Menu" /> of the [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]]<ref name="Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Nos monster/Legends|nos monster]]<ref name="Menu" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]<ref name="Guide to Alien Species" /> where they were eaten raw<ref name="Menu" /> by the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Guide to Alien Species" /> [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]].<ref name="Menu" /> 'Baby' nos ribs which consisted of a half-rack of nos monster ribs, were served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] sold its baby nos ribs for 9.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] with extra charge if the customer wanted the ribs cooked.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nos monster ribs were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
